home.title: Overview
home.content:
# Elden Ring

An open-world action RPG from FromSoftware. This page is **authored content** stored in `content/games/326243.json` — it is served to the browser as its own JSON chunk, so it costs nothing on any other route.

## Why author pages at all?

1. Content we own survives an upstream outage, a rate limit or an API deprecation.
2. A page can be richer than an upstream description dump (tables, builds, routes).
3. It is cacheable at the edge like any other immutable asset.

## Anatomy

| Layer | Where | Cost to the browser |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Manifest row | `content/index.json` | ~120 bytes |
| Search shard | `content/index-shards/e.json` | ~1 KB |
| This page | `content/games/326243.json` | only when opened |

builds.title: Starter Builds
builds.content:
## Three builds that work before you respec

### 1. Vagabond Quality
- **Stats:** 30 Vigor / 20 Endurance / 30 Str / 30 Dex
- **Weapons:** Claymore, Lordsworn's Greatsword

### 2. Astrologer Glass Cannon
- **Stats:** 25 Vigor / 60 Int
- **Weapons:** Meteorite Staff → Carian Regal Scepter

### 3. Faith Caster
- **Stats:** 30 Vigor / 50 Faith
- **Weapons:** Erdtree Seal, Blasphemous Blade
